alex kim: Quick sync — finalizing marketplace launch cadence + SI cutover plan. Need press embargo windows, landing page content freeze, HW partner assets and SI runbook by EOD. Who owns the press timeline?

maria chen: I can own press timing. Proposed windows: embargo on Tues 9am PT, public post Wed 9am PT. Need legal signoff by 3pm today. :calendar:

samir patel: HW partner (EdgeAccel) confirmed hero image and SKU mapping, will drop assets to /shared/partners/edgeaccel by 2pm. Also sending joint quote for blog.

jen lopez: SI team needs a runbook for tenant provisioning and SSO mapping. Can we freeze the on-boarding doc today? CC @samir patel for integration hooks.

alex kim: Yes — runbook freeze target 5pm. Maria, if legal misses 3pm, fallback embargo -> Wed 2pm, ok?

maria chen: That fallback works. Also we should schedule a 30min dry run tomorrow 10am PT with press ops + SI lead.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: staging landing page at https://staging.redwood.com/partner-marketplace is at 95% (missing meta tags). Remaining: meta:twitter:image, og:description.

samir patel: Adding a quick checklist for launch assets:
```
- press embargo file (legal signed)
- blog draft + images
- landing hero + meta tags
- HW partner assets in /shared/partners
- SI runbook (tenant + SSO steps)
- support playbook + escalation contacts
```

jen lopez: I'll own support playbook. Can someone add escalation contacts here? Also need a brief A/B note for landing CTA so SI knows routing. :thumbsup:
